steps.body: Some amounts need no counting at all: a quick look at two dots, or a dice-style four, and the mind names it instantly.
steps.narration: Some amounts need no counting at all: a quick look at two dots, or a dice-style four, and the mind names it instantly.

widget.prompt: Build the dice-four pattern — two on top, two below.

commonCounts.feedback: Three makes a triangle of dots; the square pattern holds one more.
Five adds a centre dot; the plain square is four.

widget.missFeedback: Place the dots as a square: two up, two down.
widget.successFeedback: Four, seen as a shape — the square of dots the eye names at once.

predict.prompt: A dice-four flashes for a moment. Can you name it without counting?
predict.reveal: Small amounts make shapes the eye recognises whole, faster than any count.

cml.actionGoal: Pair each object with exactly one number and trust the last number said for kch subitize.
invariants: A count pairs objects with number words one to one, and its last word names the whole group — which is why order, spacing, and arrangement can change without changing the answer for kch subitize.
misconceptions: Skipping or double-counting an object, recounting when nothing changed, or believing a spread-out group holds more.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more object joined the group, what would the last counting word become?

widget.prompt: A group of dots will flash. Choose the number of dots you see.

commonPicks.feedback: 2 misses 1 of the visible dots. Group the dots, then count the full group as 3.
4 counts 1 extra. Touch each dot once in your mind — the group holds 3.

widget.successFeedback: Yes — 5! You saw it like a dice face.

widget.prompt: What number comes right after 11? Hop one and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 11 stops one complete hop too soon. Continue the final 1-unit hop to reach 12.
13 goes one complete hop too far. One hop from 11 lands on 12.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 11 and count on 1: you land on 12.
widget.successFeedback: 12 — one hop forward, because each number is exactly one more than the last.
widget.lowFeedback: Short of the landing — a single hop forward reaches 12.
widget.highFeedback: Past the landing — right after 11 means one hop, stopping on 12.
